assessment.classification: Public domain-separation constant passed as HKDF salt
assessment.reason: SALT is the public ASCII protocol/version label QPeriapt-SDK-HKDF-SHA256-v1. derive passes SharedSecret bytes as IKM and binds suite,profile,state,trust-root,purpose,label,context,length in info. This constant is neither a hard-coded secret key nor a password secret. RFC5869 sections2.2 and3.1 define salt as non-secret and HKDF with or without random salt; a constant alone does not establish disclosed or predictable derived keys.
assessment.counterexample_status: No key-disclosure or predictable-output counterexample established from this warning. Assessment is scoped to the actual reported constant and dataflow, not a complete protocol proof.
